verdict.rationale: Glama is a SaaS MCP directory, gateway and hosting platform, and could plausibly open-source its code, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Glama's own source published under an open license. The open-source mentions refer to third-party MCP servers in its catalog, and the OpenAPI license block covers attribution for data use, not source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
